Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Museum Expansion (Charlie and Randy) Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6027]Museum Expansion[/url] mod Character Charlie and Randy (only includes Charlie and Randy), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. 

*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Museum Expansion mod (some where in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the "[b][ME] Museum Expansion[/b]" folder from my Zip into the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder to overwrite the "[b][ME] Museum Expansion[/b]" folder in it.

This mod replaces the default portrait of Charlie and the 'RandyRevamped'portait of Randy.
If the portraits are not showing, please make sure Charlie's portrait is set on default and Randy's portait is set on 'Revamped'.

*Since Museum Expansion added new portrait to Gunther too, I would suggest to use the Gunther portrait from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] (Patch for lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for SVE), that one has six expression Gunther.




Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6027]Museum Expansion[/url] mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6027]Museum Expansion[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68848663]andril11[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
